Game Overview

Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal is a ninja game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal?

Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal is a free ninja game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal free to play?

Yes, Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
